# Supply Chain EN

Explore demand forecasts, BOMs, MRP, procurement, stock coverage and production planning, with product-linked sales analysis.

## Capabilities

- Inspect product demand and forecasts
- Expand multilevel BOMs
- Trace MRP, purchase requests and purchase orders
- Assess stock coverage and production plans
- Link sales orders to products

object_types.name: Product BOM

data_properties.name: alt_group_no
data_properties.comment: Materials with the same nonempty alternate group under one parent can replace each other.

data_properties.name: alt_method
data_properties.comment: Direct replacement or replacement requiring modification.

data_properties.name: alt_part
data_properties.comment: Blank for main components; √ for others.

data_properties.name: bom_level
data_properties.comment: Product BOM levels range from 1 to 8; filter by product material code to count materials at each level.

data_properties.name: bom_material_code
data_properties.display_name: Product material code owning this BOM.
data_properties.comment: Filter bom_material_code by product code to retrieve the product BOM.

data_properties.name: parent_material_code
data_properties.comment: Finished product root rows have no parent material code.

data_properties.name: seq_no
data_properties.comment: BOM sequence identifies each material row within a product BOM. For example, a product with 10 materials has a sequence for each row.

data_properties.name: standard_usage
data_properties.comment: Standard quantity required to assemble the parent material.

data_properties.name: variable_loss_rate
data_properties.comment: Loss rate as a percentage; 0 means no loss.

object_types.comment: Multilevel product BOM: product → L1 components → L2 components → raw materials; types include Manufactured, Subcontracted and Purchased. Default analysis selects alt_priority == 0. Alternate groups require alt_method = 'Alternate', the same parent_material_code (falling back to bom_material_code), and the same nonempty alt_group_no. Within a group, alt_priority = 0 is the main component; alt_priority > 0 is an alternate, with lower values preferred.

object_types.name: Demand Forecast

data_properties.name: material_number
data_properties.comment: Product-based forecast keyed by the finished product material code.

data_properties.name: startdate
data_properties.comment: Required delivery date for this product forecast.

object_types.comment: Upstream product demand forecasts reflect sales demand and market expectations. Each month forecasts the next 3 months for rolling product planning. Forecast → MRP → released PR → approved PO → materials covered → production work order → forecast complete. This fixture treats product forecasts as demand plans.

object_types.name: Stock

data_properties.name: available_inventory_qty
data_properties.comment: Available stock = stock quantity - reserved quantity.

data_properties.name: expiry_date
data_properties.comment: Validity date used to identify expired or obsolete materials.

data_properties.name: inventory_uom
data_properties.comment: Units such as pcs and set.

object_types.comment: Stock quantities, status and batches by warehouse and bin. production_available includes Available stock in Suzhou Subassemblies, Suzhou Finished Goods, Suzhou Electronics, Suzhou Drone Materials, Suzhou Assembly, Urumqi Finished Goods and Harbin Finished Goods. all includes Available stock in every warehouse.

object_types.name: Material

data_properties.name: baseunit_name
data_properties.comment: Unit name, such as pcs or set.

data_properties.name: product_fixedleadtime
data_properties.comment: Production lead time in days for finished goods and subassemblies.

object_types.comment: Material master data: code, name, specification, type, units and planning parameters.

object_types.name: Monitor Task

data_properties.name: forecast_id
data_properties.comment: Each task covers exactly one demand forecast.

object_types.comment: Backward plan monitor: one product and one forecast per task, with materials as fulfillment evidence.

object_types.name: Production Plan

data_properties.name: billstatus
data_properties.comment: A: Draft, B: Submitted, C: Approved, D: Void

data_properties.name: pickstatus_title
data_properties.comment: A: Not Issued, B: Partly Issued, C: Fully Issued, D: Over-Issued

data_properties.name: sourcebillnumber
data_properties.comment: Demand forecast number referenced by the work order.

data_properties.name: taskstatus_title
data_properties.comment: [A: Not Started, B: Started, C: Complete, D: Partly Complete]

object_types.comment: Production work orders use the forecast product, quantity and dates as demand. Once MRP procurement and receipts cover the materials, release the work order and issue stock to production.

object_types.name: Material Requirements Plan

data_properties.name: adviseorderqty
data_properties.comment: Theoretical material requirement calculated by MRP.

data_properties.name: bizdropqty
data_properties.comment: Released quantity confirmed by the PMC manager and used in purchase requests and orders.

data_properties.name: bizorderqty
data_properties.comment: Actual material demand revised by PMC.

data_properties.name: closestatus_title
data_properties.comment: A: Open, B: Closed, C: Split Closed, D: Merged Closed, E: Release Closed

data_properties.name: dropbilltype_name
data_properties.comment: Material type mapping: Manufactured → production reporting; Subcontracted → standard subcontracting; Purchased → production purchase request.

data_properties.name: dropstatus_title
data_properties.comment: Release material demand into procurement: PR followed by PO.

data_properties.name: droptime
data_properties.comment: Purchase release time, used as a deterministic basis for procurement.

object_types.comment: Material requirements plan generated by ERP MRP.

object_types.name: Purchase Order

data_properties.name: srcbillentryid
data_properties.comment: Source document number matching the purchase request line ID.

data_properties.name: srcbillid
data_properties.comment: Source document number matching the purchase request ID.

data_properties.name: deliverdate
data_properties.comment: Expected delivery date; buyers can update supplier feedback in ERP.

data_properties.name: srcbillnumber
data_properties.comment: Source document number matching the purchase request number.

data_properties.name: actqty
data_properties.comment: Net receipts = received quantity - returned quantity.

object_types.comment: Formal purchase order sent to the supplier.

object_types.name: Purchase Request

data_properties.name: srcbillid
data_properties.comment: Purchase request released from a planned order and linked to the MRP ID.

data_properties.name: billtype_name
data_properties.comment: Document type, including R&D and production; this scenario covers production only.

object_types.comment: Internal purchase request (PR) generated from MRP.

object_types.name: Product

data_properties.name: material_number
data_properties.comment: Product codes are finished material codes. Every product is a material, but not every material is a product.

object_types.comment: Finished product master data, including product code and name.

object_types.name: Sales Order
object_types.comment: Sales signing and delivery records linked by product code, with customer, signed quantity, promised date and delivery details for fulfillment analysis.

object_types.name: Supplier
object_types.comment: Supplier master data: code, name, registration code, payment terms and buyer.

object_types.name: Purchase Decision

data_properties.name: decision_id
data_properties.comment: Purchase decision ID, distinct from an ERP purchase request number.

object_types.comment: Human-approved procurement decision record. This sample does not create ERP purchase requests.

object_types.name: Monitor Evidence
object_types.comment: BOM supply evidence supporting the task; materials are evidence rather than task targets.

relation_types.name: Production Plan Forecast
relation_types.comment: Production is planned from the demand forecast.

relation_types.name: Task Forecast
relation_types.comment: Task forecast relation maps forecast_id → id.

relation_types.name: Purchase Request MRP
relation_types.comment: Purchase requests released from MRP link through the source document number. Requests with no source, such as manual requests, have no MRP relation.

relation_types.name: Product Forecast
relation_types.comment: Product demand forecast, also used as the demand plan.

relation_types.name: Parent BOM

source_property.name: bom_material_code
source_property.display_name: Product material code owning this BOM.

target_property.name: bom_material_code
target_property.display_name: Product material code owning this BOM.

relation_types.comment: A BOM row links to parent rows with the same bom_material_code and material_code matching its parent_material_code. The product root is level 0. Repeated parent materials can link a child to multiple parent rows.

relation_types.name: PO Material
relation_types.comment: Material purchased by a PO line. Material ← PO → Supplier is the fixture's sole material-supplier path; no source list is provided.

relation_types.name: PO Purchase Request
relation_types.comment: Purchase orders are converted from purchase requests and linked by request line, tracing request → order.

target_property.name: bom_material_code
target_property.display_name: Product material code owning this BOM.

relation_types.name: Task Product
relation_types.comment: Each task monitors one product, keyed by material_number.

relation_types.name: Evidence Material
relation_types.comment: Material referenced as fulfillment evidence for the monitored product.

relation_types.name: Decision Product
relation_types.comment: Source product covered by the purchase decision.

relation_types.name: Decision Forecast
relation_types.comment: Demand forecast underlying the purchase decision.

relation_types.name: Decision Material
relation_types.comment: Material recommended by the purchase decision. This sample records decisions without calling ERP.

action_types.name: Create Plan Monitor
action_types.comment: Plan monitor created by a user or agent.

action_types.name: Create PO

affect.comment: Create a material purchase request from MRP, then convert it to a purchase order.

action_types.comment: Complete the PO 2 days before the material lead-time window begins so the supplier can deliver on time under the backward plan.

action_types.name: Close Monitoring Task

impact_contracts.description: Set task_status to closed without deleting history.

action_types.comment: Close a monitoring task after explicit human approval.
